THE SHUBHAM K MART GUIDELINES18 / 20
18
DESIGN VALUES, READY TO USE

Designed once.
Used consistently.

Use semantic values across CSS, JSON, design tools and components. These proposed tokens reproduce the digital system described in the source deck.

:root {
  --brand-green: #3D6948;
  --brand-gold: #F3CB2D;
  --brand-green-deep: #214B32;
  --text-primary: #192C20;
  --text-inverse: #FFFFFF;
  --surface-base: #FFFFFF;
  --surface-warm: #FBFAF4;
  --surface-tinted: #F1F6F1;
  --border-default: #DAE5DC;
  --font-latin: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-devanagari: 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif;
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px;
  --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px;
  --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px;
  --space-12: 48px; --space-16: 64px;
  --radius-sm: 8px; --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 16px;
  --content-width: 1200px;
  --button-height: 48px;
  --target-size: 44px;
  --motion-fast: 150ms;
  --motion-standard: 250ms;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Implementation notes

Proposed digital standards
01

Semantic usage

Use brand.green for brand expression and text.primary for body text. Avoid scattered one-off HEX values.

02

Typography

Inter for Latin text. Load a suitable approved script font for each regional locale.

03

Interaction

Use 48 px primary buttons, recommended 44 px touch targets and visible focus states.

04

Responsive values

Use the shared scale while allowing the composition to adapt to its content and viewport.
